description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Scripting' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule'. The class configures a scripting module for HTMLPurifier that handles 'script' and 'noscript' elements, defining their attributes, content models, and behavior within the purifier. It includes setup logic that prepares element definitions for sanitization purposes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Scripting
classes.description: A module for handling scripting elements such as <script> and <noscript> in HTML purification, defining their properties and validation logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures element definitions for 'script' and 'noscript' elements, setting attribute definitions, content models, and attribute transformations for secure HTML sanitization.
